_about: James Mark Baldwin (1861-1934), philosopher and psychologist: The Story of the Mind (New York: Appleton, 1905 printing, copyright 1898), clean Gutenberg text. Not the baldwin shelf. Added in round ab: Mental Development in the Child and the Race (New York and London: Macmillan, 1895). Added in round am: Thought and Things, or Genetic Logic, vol. I: Functional Logic (London: Swan Sonnenschein; New York: Macmillan, 1906). Added in round am: Thought and Things, or Genetic Logic, vol. II: Experimental Logic (London: Swan Sonnenschein; New York: Macmillan, 1908). Added in round am: Thought and Things, or Genetic Logic, vol. III: Interest and Art, being Real Logic I (London: George Allen; New York: Macmillan, 1911). US public domain. Added in round cm: the Handbook of Psychology (Senses and Intellect, revised edition, dated by its verso copyright of 1889; Feeling and Will, 1891), Social and Ethical Interpretations (4th ed., 1906), Development and Evolution (1902) and The Individual and Society (1911). Held: History of Psychology (1913) and Elements of Psychology (1893), because no scan found shows a printed year on its title page or verso. No uids minted.
